How many stores publish an AGENTS.md file?

In the ShopBot Index crawl of 9 November 2026, 31 of 1,248 stores we could check publish an AGENTS.md file (2.5%). Left out of the share: 1,606 stores we couldn't check. 1,164 of them were refused, and a refusal is not "no". A published file or profile is a declaration, not proof that agents can buy. ShopBot Index does not test purchases.

Big retailers first (8): Asprey, FAO Schwarz, Flying Tiger Copenhagen, Mexx, Poundland, Shopify, The Body Shop and Zellers.

How we check

We request /agents.md. It counts as published only on HTTP 200 when the body starts with # and the start of the body is not an HTML page. We check it alongside /llms.txt. A store is one we could check when at least one website returned that file or a not-found response. Refusals, errors and checks we did not reach are left out. A store counts when at least one of its websites meets the rule. This page counts stores. The Beyond UCP table counts websites, so the two numbers can differ. How we check.
